 This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition
and the affidavit filed in support of Wp(C) and upon hearing the arguments
of M/S S.S.Aravind, M.V.Amaresan, Premanand E. and Karthik.V., Advocates
for the petitioner, Government Pleader for R1 to R4 and R6,
Sri.M.Sasindran, Advocate for R5, M/S T.Madhu, C.R.Saradamani, Renjish S.
Menon, Vrinda T.S., Aiswarya Jayapal, Advocates for R7 and R8, the court
passed the following:
 p.t.o
 Devan Ramachandran, J.
 =========================
 W.P.(C).No. 19941 of 2023
 ==========================
 Dated this the 8th day of November, 2023
 Order
Sri.Grashious Kuriakose - learned Additional Director General of Prosecution, instructed by the
learned

Government Pleader for the State of Kerala and its functionaries, submitted that, to his
informa
tion, there are no guidelines for parameters with respect to the food item called "Shawarma".

He added that most of the accidents that have been recently reported with respect to the consumption of this food appear to be on account of complications raising from the delayed use of a food raw material called "Mayonnaise".
He added that, for this perhaps, the competent Authority of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), may have to be brought on record.

sentences.text: 2. Before this Court can take a decision on these aspects, certainly, am of the view that the Food Safety Commissioner must explain what steps have been taken, particularly with respect to the food item in question.
Though unsubstantiated yet, fatal food poisoning incidents occurring on account of this article appear to be on the rise.
Unfortunately, the aficionados of this food are the younger generation most of the time; and as is reflected in this case, the child who unfortunately died of food poisoning was only 16 years in age.

3. In the afore circumstances, I direct the Food Safety Commissioner to appear online on 14.11.2023 at 1.45 p.m., for an interaction, particularly as to what can be done to avert such instances, at least in future.
4. As regards the claim of compensation by the petitioner, the matter will be considered in due course.

H/o.
Sd/-
DEVAN RAMACHANDRAN JUDGE anm 08-11-2023 /True Copy/
